bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
logs="$(docker logs --tail 120 "$name" 2>&1 || true)"
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Fq '/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token';then exit 80;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Fq '/run/secrets/videobot_db_password';then exit 81;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Fq '/opt/videobot';then exit 82;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Fq '/tmp/';then exit 83;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Fq '/run/secrets';then exit 84;fi
exit 90
